exact_statement: Let S,W,U,V be compatible point indicators on disjoint uniform blocks of positive widths s,L,R,T and g an independent balanced Boolean core. For F=1+[WUV OR S(U OR V)](g-1), query the separator S until first failure or completion, then resolve WUV or U OR V and stop at a constant or g. Put alpha=2^-s, q=2^-R,r=2^-T,eta=2^-(L+R+T),e=q+r-qr-eta,JB=(L+R+T)eta,JC=R q(1-r)+T r(1-q),JD=JB+JC,pi=eta+alpha e,m=ceil(log2(min(R,T)+2))+2 and M=min(s,m). Every live separator query with j>m remaining bits is strictly K=4-good. The nonnegative reserve at live state j is V_j=2^-j[min(j,m) JD+e min(j,m)(min(j,m)-1)/2+min(j,m)e I(g)], set zero after failure. Its exact physical drift V_j-V_(j-1)/2 equals the actual child-product face price c_j=2^-j[JD+(j-1)e+e I(g)] when j<=m and zero otherwise. Thus the actual localized separator bill is <=V_s<=M I_other+(M-1)I_sep/2+M I_terminal<=M I(F), where I_sep=s alpha e,I_other=(1-alpha)JB+alpha JC,I_terminal=pi I(g). Terminal entropy remains pi H(g), and H(F)<=(4+2/ln2)(I_sep+I_other)+V_s+pi H(g). This eliminates dependence on separator length s for fixed R,T, but is not a universal influence constant or terminal-core certificate.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs on uniform cube; entropy and logarithms in bits
Compatible point literals; disjoint fresh separator/controller blocks independent of g
Independent balanced core; full pi H(g) retained at stopping leaves
History-measurable physical policy exactly as specified; one query per coordinate along each path
V is a cutoff-envelope reserve and may charge eligible but actually good layers; it is not renewed at descendants

exact_statement: Let S,W,U,V be independent compatible point indicators on disjoint uniform blocks of positive widths s,L,R,T, and let g be an independent balanced Boolean sign. Set F=1+[WUV OR S(U OR V)](g-1), q=2^-R,r=2^-T,eta=2^-(L+R+T),e=q+r-qr-eta,alpha=2^-s,JB=(L+R+T)eta,JC=R q(1-r)+T r(1-q),JD=JB+JC,pi=eta+alpha e. Query S until failure or completion, then resolve WUV or U OR V and stop at a constant or the actual g. For e<=1/8 every live separator query has B_i/Inf_i<1781/480<4. In particular min(R,T)>=4 gives zero localized strict-K4 bad-control-prefix bill for every s,L. Otherwise define m_*=ceil(log2(min(R,T)+2))+2<=5; in the rare regime define m_*=0. The reserve at live layer j is W_j=2^-j[M_j JD+e M_j(M_j-1)/2+M_j e I(g)], M_j=min(j,m_*), and is zero after separator failure. Its physical drift equals the actual child-product face price c_j=2^-j[JD+(j-1)e+e I(g)] at j<=m_* and zero otherwise. Every possible bad-layer debit is bounded by this drift. With I_sep=s alpha e,I_other=(1-alpha)JB+alpha JC,I_terminal=pi I(g), the entire controller-prefix bad bill obeys Q_bad<=W_s<=5 I_other+2 I_sep+5 I_terminal<=5 I(F), uniformly in all widths and core dimension. Terminal entropy remains pi H(g). Moreover H(F)<=(4+2/ln2)(I_sep+I_other)+W_s+pi H(g); with a separately proved terminal rate C0, H(F)<=max(9+2/ln2,C0+5)I(F). No prescribed-witness funding, arbitrary unbalanced-core K4 bound or general nested-selector reserve is asserted.
hypotheses: Actual uniform Boolean signs; entropy and logarithms in bits; physical pivotal influences and history reaches
Independent balanced core g and disjoint compatible positive point blocks of the specified widths

Q_bad is strict-K4 bad-node face price, not the unfiltered old V envelope or bad nodes inside the stopped core
All terminal pi H(g) is retained; any C0 is a separately certified inherited core rate; no spectral reference bank is assumed free
